On 2nd December Cllr Tudor Griffiths, Town Mayor, Chepstow Town Council, and The Chepstow Society hosted a special ceremony to mark 500 years since the 1524 Charter was granted to the people of Chepstow by Charles Somerset, 1st Earl of Worcester. We were honoured to welcome the Lord Lieutenant of Gwent and the 12th Duke and Duchess of Beaufort (descendants of the 1st Earl of Worcester) for this historic occasion. Cllr Tudor Griffiths, Town Mayor, hosted a Mayor’s Reception at St Mary’s Priory Church to welcome visitors from Cormeilles, here as part of the Chepstow-Cormeilles Twinning Society. As a special gesture, our guests presented us with a replica of the boat used by William the Conqueror to cross the Channel (La Manche) during his conquest of Britain.
